findings.text: Provides a read-only lookup with one entry per possible byte value that translates an input byte to its bit-reversed image for fast reversal without per-bit computation.
Bit-reversal lookup holds exactly 256 one-byte entries, with the first entry mapping zero to zero and the last entry mapping all-ones to all-ones.

Exposes init-time accessors for an embedded configuration blob and an embedded command line, covering size reporting with null on empty, prepend of embedded text into a caller buffer, and a query for whether that prepend happened.

Prepend ignores empty destination capacity or embedded content holding only a terminator, excludes that terminator from the moved length, measures existing text with bounded length, refuses overflow while keeping old content, otherwise shifts existing bytes forward including terminator and copies embedded bytes at the front then records success.

Offers an init-time probe that copies a boot command line into a fixed temporary buffer, runs generic option parsing with a callback that recognizes one opt-in name, reports whether it was found, and optionally reports the offset where parsing stopped.

String primitives provide bounded length measurement stopping at terminator or limit, unsigned-byte lexicographic comparison returning negative zero or positive with length-limited variant, first-occurrence search for any member of a set, and leading plus trailing whitespace removal.
Provides a variadic formatted-output wrapper that forwards its variable arguments to the sized formatting engine and returns the resulting length.

Provides tree query operations for counts and sizes, root access, index computation, parent child and next navigation, payload retrieval, dotted subkey and value lookup, dotted key composition, leaf and key-value iteration, and rendering of the tree as command-line text.

Nodes reside in one contiguous pool addressed by position; links are stored as indices where zero child or next means absent and a maximum-index parent sentinel means no parent; the payload field combines a pool offset with a flag bit that is masked away before indexing the data pool.

Two allocation variants exist: an early variant allocating with cache-line alignment and releasing through the same early mechanism regardless of timing flag, and an alternate variant using zeroed host allocation with plain release ignoring size and timing; one inflate release variant reference-counts and resets a bump pointer at zero while another aliases kernel release.

Top-level tree parsing repeatedly scans for structural delimiters, then dispatches plain assignment, colon-equals and plus-equals forms that each require a following equals sign, brace open, comment or separator or newline as end of key, and brace close, stopping on first error or when no delimiter remains and trailing blank is accepted.

Value scanning accepts an optional single or double quote, only printable or space characters, closing-quote handling that requires a valid following delimiter, unquoted termination on comma semicolon newline comment or closing brace with surrounding whitespace trimmed, comment skipping treated as newline, and distinct errors for bad characters, missing delimiters and unterminated quotes.

Key insertion trims dotted names, splits on dots, accepts only alphanumerics plus dash and underscore, reuses a matching existing node when present else appends a new node, keeps the value node as first child, rejects redefinition with plain assignment, overwrites in place while preserving sibling linkage for colon form, appends after the deepest child for plus form, chains comma-separated values as arrays, and pushes or pops a brace stack on nesting changes.

Tree verification requires balanced braces, a non-empty node set, child and next indices strictly inside the allocated count, and a traversal that enforces maximum dotted key length and maximum nesting depth.

Lookup and rendering match one dotted component at a time with dot or terminator required after a match, descend while input remains, return first value text or empty string for valueless keys, compose a dotted path by collecting ancestor indices then formatting with separators while tracking would-be length, iterate leaves by descending to leaves and climbing via parents, and quote rendered values only when they contain whitespace while skipping a root-that-is-its-own-leaf.

Failure handling includes ignoring oversized prepend, warning plus null on payload offset overrun or invalid leaf iteration state, rejecting null or self-relative composition and depth or ancestry violations, null on node exhaustion, distinct negative statuses for absent data invalid input range excess exhaustion and empty input, and size probing that never performs arithmetic on a null buffer while still accumulating would-be length.
Embedded-blob retrieval, embedded command-line prepend, and command-line opt-in probing act as init-phase entry points used before main configuration parsing to obtain inputs and decide enablement.

Init-time global storage comprises an applied flag, node pool pointer plus node count, data pool pointer plus data size, last-parent pointer, error message plus error position, brace stack plus stack index, and a fixed key-name buffer alongside a fixed temporary command-line buffer.

Named limits govern command-line capacity, brace nesting depth, maximum key text length, maximum node count, maximum data capacity and the value flag bit, with negative statuses distinguishing absent device, invalid argument, range excess, no memory and no entry.
